summary: Prompt 21 pre-launch frontend E2E on Expo web (390x800). CRITICAL BLOCKER FOUND: /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL which in /app/frontend/.env points to production https://api.hogoplus.in — but that DB has no demo accounts, so demo OTP 123456 returns 401 for +919000000113 / +919000000101 / +919000000500. Verified via curl: preview backend accepts demo OTP (200), production API rejects (401 'Invalid OTP'). To unblock testing I temporarily set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to the preview URL, re-ran the flows, then REVERTED the .env change back to https://api.hogoplus.in (both edits committed via search_replace). After the temporary override, all Prompt 21 Time Office frontend flows were verified end-to-end. Escalate flow was NOT re-tested in-browser (approvals-tab session lost between browser_automation invocations because localStorage isn't shared across calls); backend escalate contracts are already 17/17 green in iter16 (dept + person modes, fallback, reason<3 422).

integration_issues.flow: API base URL misconfigured for preview
integration_issues.issue: src/api/client.ts:5 uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL which is https://api.hogoplus.in (production). Preview web build therefore hits production API, where demo phones (+91900000xxxx) are not seeded/whitelisted, so all demo logins return 401 'Invalid OTP'. Either (a) switch client.ts to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, or (b) point EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to the preview URL in the preview environment while keeping production build config separate. Reference: /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts:5, /app/frontend/.env

context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL: Before touching UI on the preview web (port 3000), verify /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is pointing at the preview backend, not https://api.hogoplus.in. If it's the prod URL, demo OTP will return 401 for every demo phone and nothing on the UI is testable. Recommended workaround (do NOT commit): flip EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to https://hogo-backend-phase1.preview.emergentagent.com, `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`, run tests, then revert. Also: page.fill and page.keyboard.type do NOT reliably drive RN Web TextInputs — use this JS shim to trigger onChangeText: `page.evaluate((sel,val)=>{const el=document.querySelector(sel); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(el,val); el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,data:val,inputType:'insertText'}));}, sel, val)`. mcp_browser_automation invocations DO NOT share localStorage/sessionStorage; put the entire flow in a single script or you'll bounce back to /phone. Approvals tab has segmented sub-tabs (Forms/Registrations/Swaps/Complaints) — after landing on /approvals click the 'Complaints' segment to see approval-incident rows; the sub-tab does NOT have a stable testID (nice-to-add: approvals-segment-incidents).
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of demo login 401: frontend/src/api/client.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL, and frontend/.env sets that to https://api.hogoplus.in (production). Production DB does not have the demo cast seeded / DEMO_OTP_ENABLED is false, so /api/auth/verify-otp with OTP '123456' → 401 'Invalid OTP'. The rest of the .env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) is correctly set to the preview host but is unused by the API client. FIX: update client.ts to `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` OR maintain a preview-only .env with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=preview URL. Confirmed by direct curl (preview /api/auth/verify-otp → 200 with tokens; prod /api/auth/verify-otp → 401 'Invalid OTP').
